# Premium Selling Morning Brief
**Date:** October 8, 2026

---

## 1. MARKET CONTEXT

Markets are treading water with SPY and QQQ flat at $777.22 and $757.73 respectively, while VIX climbed 5.84% to $15.96, signaling modest uptick in hedging demand. Low HV ranks across the board (SPY 23, QQQ 18) indicate compressed realized volatility, though elevated VIX relative to HV suggests modest premium selling opportunities remain. Environment is **neutral-to-favorable** for disciplined premium selling with tight risk management—focus on high-quality setups with adequate cushion given the low volatility regime.

---

## 7. KEY RISKS / FLAGS

- **Earnings cluster risk**: TSLA (10/21), MSFT (10/28), AMZN (10/29), GOOGL (10/28), and LLY (10/29) create vol uncertainty Oct 20-30—our 15-22 DTE positions span this window; monitor closely for early exit opportunities if IV spikes materially.
- **Low HV environment**: Multiple tickers (NVDA, LLY, PLTR, GILD) at HV rank 0-2 signals compressed realized vol; any macro shock could trigger sharp mean reversion—size conservatively and maintain stop discipline.
- **VIX disconnect**: VIX up 5.84% while SPY/QQQ flat suggests hedging demand building; if VIX breaks above $17-18, consider reducing exposure as regime may shift bearish quickly.
